title: Locate the first failing connectivity layer
method: Synthetic 20-path inventory: 12+4+3+1=20. Classification uses the first failing layer; retest after repair. This inventory does not estimate production availability.
alt: Locate the first failing connectivity layer: All checks pass 12 paths, DNS mismatch 4 paths, Route or policy 3 paths, Authorization 1 paths. Illustrative inputs.
